source.notes: PKLITE Professional 1.12 unpacked at offset 752 with depklite -d. 477 functions decompiled.

video_mode.default_vga: mode 0x13 variant, 320x400 256-color, base 0xa000:0x0000 (confirmed at FUN_2000_846c, FUN_2000_a50b)

global_pointers.0x7760: VGA segment (0xa000) — set at init, read by draw routines
global_pointers.0x77f8: another dispatched function pointer (called from FUN_1000_0cb0)
global_pointers.0xad8: jump table base for dispatch at FUN_1000_0aa8 — Ghidra flagged 'too many branches' (likely main algorithm dispatcher)

string_table.layout: contiguous null-terminated ASCII, alphabetical within each group

runtime_architecture.dispatch: Alt-<key> and Ctl-<key> select image algorithm. Capital letter inside effect name = Alt-key shortcut (e.g. Starburst → Alt-S, firewOrks → Alt-O).

shapes.description: Low-level pattern generators — draw geometric primitives. Lowercase names, all alphabetical in string table.

effects.name: corkscrew
effects.inferred: helical spiral traced as 3D curve projected to 2D

effects.name: tunnel
effects.inferred: concentric scaled shapes for tunnel illusion

effects.name: butterflies
effects.inferred: butterfly curve x=sin(t)(e^cos t - 2cos 4t - sin^5 t/12)

effect_modes.description: Higher-level effect modes invoked by Alt-<capital letter>. The capital letter in the name is the hotkey.

effects.name: Juggle palette
effects.inferred: shuffle palette entries for color-cycle chaos

effects.name: Starburst
effects.inferred: radial line burst from point (has dedicated `star_burst` routine per error strings)

port_plan.approach: Reimplement each effect as a pure Python function `fn(frame_index, params, audio_features) -> np.ndarray[320,200,3]` or similar RGB buffer.
port_plan.audio_hook: Parameters that were hardcoded in the C source (speed, amplitude, color-cycle rate, particle count, radius) become mapped to FFT bands or RMS amplitude.
order_of_attack: 1. Build shared infrastructure: VGA-style 8-bit palette buffer, palette-cycling loop, double buffering, audio FFT reader.
2. Port the simplest shape generators first: lines, dots, wandering, spiral — all tiny algorithms, good for validating pipeline.
3. Port structural algorithms: sierpinski (chaos game), hilbert (recursive), butterflies (parametric curve).
4. Port effect-mode post-processors: Exclusive-or (XOR blit), Gas cloud (plasma noise), Juggle palette (palette permutation).
5. Port Starburst (has explicit `star_burst` function reference — can find in decompile).
6. Pan/scroll is low-priority — it relied on VGA dual-page hardware that Python doesn't need.

audio_mapping_examples.bass_rms: particle count (firewOrks), spiral tightness (corkscrew), tunnel zoom speed
audio_mapping_examples.overall_energy: brightness / alpha blend with prior frame

high_value_functions: FUN_1000_0aa8 — jump table at 0xad8 (likely main algorithm dispatcher, index = param_1 >> 2)
FUN_2000_a50b — main effect runner; stores 0xa000 at global 0x7760 and calls *(0x5c33)()
FUN_2000_846c — PCX decoder (uses FUN_2000_83a1 RLE inner loop)
Function referencing 'star_burst' error string — Starburst implementation entry point
uncracked: Mapping from image-name index → function address. The name table is at 0x2a300 but pointers to these strings aren't in a form Ghidra's auto-analysis picked up; next step would be manually defining a far-pointer array in Ghidra at a promising offset (likely near 0xad8 or near 0x745a which the code uses as a base).
